biggest_catch: Your friend must open a NEW Beacon checking account and complete direct deposits totaling $300+, ten debit card transactions, and eStatements enrollment within 60 days of opening — and rewards are capped at $500 per calendar year.
catches: Referred friend must register for the offer using your personal referral link, open a new Beacon Credit Union checking account within 90 days of registering, and within 60 days of account opening: complete direct deposits totaling $300 or more, complete ten debit card transactions (excluding ATM withdrawals), and enroll in online banking with eStatements.
Rewards are capped at $500 per calendar year (ten $50 referrals) for the referrer.
Reward is a $50 Visa Reward Card (not cash); allow 4-6 weeks for delivery after all requirements are completed.

Account must be open and in good standing at the time of qualification; offer valid only for the friend's first checking account with Beacon. Membership eligibility determined at account opening; $5 minimum membership share account required.
The program may be changed or discontinued at any time.

steps: Register for the Beacon Credit Union Referral Program using the registration form on beaconcu.org/refer-a-friend (or the ReferLive app).
Invite friends and family by sharing your personal referral link, email, or social media.
Your friend registers for the referral offer using your link and opens a new Beacon Credit Union checking account (within 90 days of registering).

Within 60 days of account opening, the friend: completes direct deposits totaling $300 or more, completes ten debit card transactions (excluding ATM withdrawals), and enrolls in online banking with eStatements.
You and your friend each receive a $50 Visa Reward Card, delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed.
timing: Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed; friend must open account within 90 days of registering and qualify within 60 days of account opening.
when_cash_arrives: Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed; friend must open account within 90 days of registering and qualify within 60 days of account opening. The payout clock starts when your friend finishes qualifying, and the reward arrives as a mailed (or emailed) Reward Card 4-6 weeks later.
maximize: Start the clock ASAP: the 4-6-week card window only begins after your friend completes every requirement - have them qualify in the first days of the window, not the last.
Front-load the friend's activity (debit transactions, direct deposit) so verification does not push delivery past 6 weeks.
Watch for a redemption email - some ReferLive programs issue virtual cards faster than physical mail.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: payout is a Reward Card with a 4-6-week delivery window baked into the terms - qualification speed is the only lever.
